title: Manchego-Stuffed Shishito Poppers
blurb: Manchego holds its shape better than a softer cheese under the broiler, so the filling chars at the edges instead of just melting out of the pepper.
steps: Position a rack in the upper third of the oven; preheat the broiler to high.
Combine the manchego, yogurt, scallions, panko, paprika and garlic powder in a medium bowl.

Make a slit down one side of each pepper and scrape out the seeds with a small spoon. Fill each with about 1½ tsp of the cheese mixture and close the pepper around it. Place cut-side up on a baking sheet and coat lightly with cooking spray.
Broil, turning the pan once from front to back halfway through, until the peppers start to char and the cheese melts, about 4 minutes total. Sprinkle with salt and serve warm.
